row.scope_boundary: generic fixed-radius component-union labels; not full DBSCAN paper reproduction and not a broad RTDBSCAN app speedup claim

variants.expected_route: embree prepared fixed-radius core flags plus generic component-union labels

variants.role: current M37 Phoenix V3 productized runner route

pre_run_gates: M38 must obtain 2-AI review before any focused POD run.
The productized runner harness must exist and pass local dry-run/unit tests before POD.
The POD must pass the OptiX RT hardware gate on the same RTX-class hardware used for Phoenix focused probes, or a new hardware-gate review must approve the change.
All variants must use the same generated clustered 3D points, same radius, same min_neighbors, warmup=1, repeat=5, and separate output files.
Component-signature rows cannot replace component-union label rows; signature is allowed only as a canonical correctness digest after labels exist.
The runner route must expose M37 metadata; otherwise the run is classified as harness failure, not performance evidence.
The runner process must print heartbeat output at least every 30 seconds.
No all-app run may be started from this protocol.

success_bars.correctness: all variants must produce matching canonical component signatures from component-label outputs
success_bars.productized_runtime: runner metadata must set runtime_executed=true, productized_execution_path=prepared_execution_session_runner, runtime_trunk_executes_end_to_end=true, component_union_phase_accounting_visible=true, component_label_columns_present=true, and component_signature_pass_executed=false
success_bars.material_set_a_candidate: runner OptiX must beat Embree same-contract control by at least 1.20x on both hot query median and runner-inclusive wall
success_bars.legacy_no_regression: runner-inclusive wall must be at least 0.98x of the legacy OptiX grouped-stream component-label route, or the result is productized coverage only
success_bars.claim_boundary: all release/public/broad V3-over-V2/V4/zero-copy flags must remain false

failure_classification.no_runner_harness: stop and create/review a local M39 runner harness; do not spend POD
failure_classification.correctness_mismatch: stop; correctness failure, no performance interpretation
failure_classification.metadata_missing: classify as productized-runner failure, no Set-A credit
failure_classification.runner_slower_than_embree_or_below_1_20x: classify as coverage or negative evidence, no material component-union credit
failure_classification.runner_regresses_vs_legacy_below_0_98x: classify as productized coverage only unless 2-AI accepts a specific justified exception

recommended_next_step.note: Because no reviewed focused M37 component-union runner harness exists yet, the conservative next step is local harness implementation and dry-run gates before any POD spend.

decision_audit.decision: write a focused component-union protocol instead of running POD immediately after M37
decision_audit.foolish_actions: It would be foolish to spend POD before freezing labels-vs-signature semantics, controls, metrics, resource cap, and fail-closed interpretation.
decision_audit.other_path: Run a focused POD immediately because the core node exists. That risks measuring an unreviewed harness or component-signature shortcut and learning little about the V3 runtime trunk.
decision_audit.different_path_now: Freeze the exact row, variants, metadata gates, success bars, failure classifications, and cost cap; then seek 2-AI review before spending POD.
